reason: My guests find me on Google Maps, Glovo and Wolt, and the menu already lives there. A website is one more place to keep updated, and I don't see who actually lands on it, so 25 euros a month on top of everything else is hard to justify.
objection: Who do I call when it breaks at 7:30 with a queue at the counter? If there is no real person in Bulgaria who picks up the phone, an AI that pushes my prices live is a risk, not a help.
would_change_my_mind: If the same WhatsApp message also updated my hours and menu on Google Maps and Glovo/Wolt, and there was a Bulgarian person I could phone when something goes wrong.
